description: OCTAS provides a plugin-based framework coupling transport, automation, robotics and AI simulations. The provider is Fraunhofer IOSB and partners. Geographical and temporal coverage: Users combine open or commercial plugins to define scenarios and levels of detail; no fixed geographic coverage applies. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0 for the core; plugin terms differ. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Commercial plugins can have additional costs; a free core does not make every assembled simulation free. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
